movie_title: The joys of writing lists ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: Shopping lists, to-do lists, check lists – when was the last time you made, or followed, a list? ⭐ F

vocabulary.definition: strange and ugly in a way that is not normal
vocabulary.example: The horror movie featured grotesque monsters.

vocabulary.definition: to shorten a word or phrase
vocabulary.example: Please abbreviate the company name to fit in the form.

vocabulary.definition: people trained in a particular type of therapy or treatment
vocabulary.example: Therapists help patients cope with mental health issues.

vocabulary.definition: a piece of paper with exercises or questions for students to complete
vocabulary.example: The teacher handed out a worksheet for homework.

vocabulary.definition: to express disapproval of someone or something
vocabulary.example: The film criticise criticized the movie for its poor acting.

vocabulary.definition: a list of dishes available in a restaurant
vocabulary.example: The menu had a variety of options including vegetarian dishes.
